draft.title: Methods of control
card: Propaganda
Messages designed to shape what people think, spread through posters, films, radio and rallies. It aims to win support and build loyalty to the leader.
Censorship
Control over what people can read, hear and say. Newspapers, books, films and radio are checked or banned, so opposing views are kept from the public.
Secret police
Forces that spy on citizens and arrest opponents, often without a fair trial. Examples are the Gestapo in Nazi Germany and the NKVD in the Soviet Union.
Youth movements and terror
Youth groups, such as the Hitler Youth, taught children loyalty to the regime. Terror, such as arrests, camps and executions, scared people into obeying.
draft.remember: Dictators used some methods to win support and others to force it.

a.q: Which method of control was used mainly to shape young people's beliefs in favour of the regime?
a.why: Youth movements such as the Hitler Youth brought children into groups that taught loyalty to the regime. Censorship also shaped what people knew, but it worked by blocking information from everyone, not by training young people.
a.clue: Which method was built around groups for children?

b.q: A regime bans a newspaper that criticised the leader, and the editor is secretly arrested. Which two methods are being used?
b.why: Banning the newspaper is censorship, because it stops criticism reaching the public. Secretly arresting the editor is the work of secret police. Propaganda is tempting, but it spreads the regime's own messages and does not ban others.
b.clue: One method blocks information, and the other deals with people.

a.q: Which of these aimed mainly to win people's support, rather than scare them into obeying?
a.why: Propaganda tries to change what people think, so they support the leader willingly. Secret police surveillance may seem quieter than executions, but it still works through fear of being watched and arrested, so it forces obedience rather than winning support.
a.clue: Which one tries to change minds rather than create fear?
